bootstrap.dependence: move all 25 conditions and both rollouts for each sampled item together

distance.missingness: no complete-case filtering; model outcomes retained as errors

error: e=0 iff external-semantic-v3 correct; valid-wrong, invalid, unevaluable, truncation, and model runtime outcome are e=1
leave_one_direction_out: ten diagnostics; remove one base direction and all incident pairs, recompute aggregate family-balanced rho

multiplicity.justification: M0/M1/M2 are three competing pre-outcome hypotheses; an exact max-statistic family QAP controls their shared existence claim before metric attribution
multiplicity.max_statistic: maximum aggregate family-balanced rho across M0/M1/M2
multiplicity.p_value: number of exact null statistics >= observed divided by 3840, identity included
multiplicity.qap_space: exact 5! family-block permutations x 2^5 within-family location swaps = 3840
multiplicity.shell_handling: same family/location mapping applied to both shells

primary_pairs: 40 cross-family base-direction dyads per shell; 80 shell-stratified dyads

radial_claim.role: secondary control claim, reported independently as R+ or R-

relational_gate.positive_family_summary_definition: mean of that family's two shell-specific incident-dyad rhos > 0

spearman.aggregate: arithmetic mean of MEDIUM and STRONG shell summaries
spearman.family_summary: for each family and shell, rho over 16 incident cross-family dyads
spearman.shell_summary: arithmetic mean of five family incident-dyad rhos

threshold_justifications.bootstrap_lower_0: Item-cluster uncertainty must exclude a nonpositive aggregate association while preserving all condition/rollout dependence.
threshold_justifications.both_shells: The relation must survive the twofold radial manipulation and therefore cannot be a single-shell accident.
threshold_justifications.four_of_five_families: A relational claim must be distributed across new conceptual families rather than driven by one or two families.
threshold_justifications.lodo_positive: No one of the ten prospectively constructed directions may determine the sign.
threshold_justifications.m2_delta_0_10: Specific necessity of finite output response requires a scientifically material paired rank improvement, not merely nominal significance.
threshold_justifications.qap_0_05: The exact family-constrained max statistic provides finite-sample family-wise control across all three prespecified metrics.
threshold_justifications.rho_0_25: A moderate rank effect is required because N=200 chiefly reduces item noise; prior dependence-preserving simulations showed family novelty remains dominant and did not justify a smaller scientific effect.
